lead: `nvs-server`'s `a_fleet_lease_is_renewed_while_its_run_is_in_flight` fails under `nv verify` and passes alone.
body: It asserts a lease was renewed inside a wall-clock window, and 160 sibling tests sharing the machine widen it. Re-run it with `cargo test -p nvs-server --lib schedule::tests::a_fleet_lease_is_renewed_while_its_run_is_in_flight`, and when it passes finish the gate by hand: `cargo clippy --all-targets`, then `nvs test tests/conformance`.

until.arg: crates/nvs-server/src/schedule.rs:the key was held again while the run was in flight
